sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gaiblín is another name for the Irish hero Gavida. Some sources also call him Gaibhleen or Goibhleann. Gavida was the brother of Cian and the uncle of the hero Lugh. He fostered Lugh until the youth was old enough to slay his monstrous grandfather Bálor of the Evil Eye. Some accounts identify Gavida with the smith god Goibniu. See Gavida.
